timing.summary_statistic: median observer score over remaining within-phase repeated measurements

event_side.event_restore: remove target-only attenuation or replace with canonical high-visibility target while leaving nuisance/optical state unchanged
event_side.observability_restore: neutralise nuisance source only; target attenuation remains
event_side.shared_restore: remove shared optical element only; target attenuation remains

nuisance_side.event_restore: canonical local target reference while fan treatment remains active
nuisance_side.observability_restore: fan treatment off while event target and shared optical state remain unchanged
nuisance_side.shared_restore: remove shared optical element only while fan treatment remains active

shared_optical.latent_impairment: partial optical occlusion affecting target and scene
shared_optical.event_restore: canonical local target reference introduced without removing optical occluder
shared_optical.observability_restore: neutralise nuisance source without removing optical occluder
shared_optical.shared_restore: remove the optical occluder while event/nuisance conditions remain unchanged

event_side.event_restore: return target to canonical development-independent reference size/visibility
event_side.shared_restore: remove heldout shared optical element only

nuisance_side.latent_impairment: moving shadow or controlled illumination nuisance
nuisance_side.event_restore: canonical local target reference while lighting nuisance remains
nuisance_side.observability_restore: stop or neutralise the lighting nuisance without changing target or shared optical state
nuisance_side.shared_restore: remove shared optical element only while lighting nuisance remains

shared_optical.event_restore: canonical local target reference without removing glare/diffusion condition
shared_optical.observability_restore: neutralise nuisance source without removing glare/diffusion condition
shared_optical.shared_restore: remove glare/diffusion condition while target/nuisance states remain unchanged
